text:
marco: Quick heads-up — product team expects EU traffic spike in Q2. We need to request quota increases in eu-west-1 for GPU instances and networking limits to support a Dedicated pool expansion. Forecast attached below.

lina: Summary from capacity planning: we expect +120 GPUs over 12 weeks, ramping 40/40/40. We want 20% headroom for bursts (so target request = 144 GPUs). Prefer mix: 64 x a10g (cost-efficient), 64 x a100/40g for high-throughput customers, remainder as flexible spot.

devon: Confirming cloud vendor = AWS? If so we need EC2 instance quota increases (p4d/p4de and g4ad/a10g counts are separate), ENI and IP quotas, and EFA quotas for multi-node training fallbacks. Also check Service Quotas for "Running On-Demand Standard (A, C, D, G, H) instances" by family.

marco: Yes AWS eu-west-1. Dedicated customers require pinned on-demand capacity for 80 GPUs (reserved pool). The rest can be a mix of reserved + spot. Need ETA on support case lead times.

devon: Typical timelines: p4d/p4de requests 2–4 weeks (capacity availability dependent), a10g/g4 counts usually 48–72h for quota approvals but physical capacity sometimes longer. ENI/IP quota increases are usually quick (same day or 24h). EFA requests need partner approval 1–2 weeks.

ash: Cost check — if we reserve 80 on-demand A100-class GPUs for 12 months (no RI), estimate monthly delta ~ $200k? Need exact calc from finance. For spots/ops we should include automated fallback so customer SLAs aren't impacted.

lina: Draft support case payload (paste into AWS support console):

```
Subject: Request quota increase for GPU instance types and ENI/IPs in eu-west-1
Body:
- Account ID: 123456789012
- Desired effective date: 2026-04-15
- Requested increases:
  - p4d.24xlarge (A100) On-Demand: current 0 -> desired 40
  - p4de.24xlarge On-Demand: current 0 -> desired 24
  - g5.12xlarge / a10g equivalent: current 16 -> desired 80
  - Elastic Network Interfaces (ENI) quota: current 1000 -> desired 3000
  - Private IPv4 address quota: current 2000 -> desired 6000
  - Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) entitlement: request enablement on account for eu-west-1
- Reason: Support Dedicated customer rollout + burst headroom for ML inference workloads. Include planned usage timeline, throughput targets, and expected monthly spend.
```

devon: Good. Add a note to ask for regional capacity confirmation (are any AZs constrained?). Also request a case type: "Quota increase" and choose "EC2" as service. Attach our forecast table (CSV) to the case.

marco: Action items: (1) devon to open quota cases, (2) lina to attach forecast CSV, (3) ash to prepare preliminary cost delta and finance sign-off. Please put owners and case IDs in this thread.

devon: I'll open cases this morning. Will ping case IDs here. If AWS asks for architecture details, use the short description: "Inference clusters for low-latency LLM serving, horizontal autoscaling with reserved pool for SLAs."

ash: Finance needs a worst-case monthly burn and a 6-month projection. Lina, can you export the ramp scenario with hourly p95 concurrency?

lina: Yep, uploading the CSV to the eng-infra drive now. Link: https://redwoodinternal/drive/infra/quota-requests/eu-west1-forecast.csv (internal)

sre-bot: Monthly quota check alert: ec2-gpu-family remaining = 18% in eu-west-1. Recommend filing increases ASAP.

ops-runbooks-bot: Runbook: infra/quota-requests.md - steps for generating support case and escalation path: https://redwoodinternal/runbooks/quota-requests

devon: Case created: case# 9876543210 (EC2 quotas). Requested increases match draft. AWS asked for confirmed usage start date and contact email — I set start date 2026-04-15 and contact infra-ops@redwood.ai.

marco: Thanks. Keep monitoring AZ-level capacity and consider multi-region fallback if AWS response shows constraints. If we can't get p4d in eu-west-1 in time, fallback plan = increase a10g pool + route heavy multitenant jobs to us-west-2.

lina: I'll update the capacity dashboard with fallback mappings and update the rollout plan.

ash: Once we have case approval, finance will allocate a purchase order for reserved capacity. Hold on final reservations until we confirm sustained utilization > 70% for 2 weeks.

devon: Follow-up: I also opened a second case for ENI/IP quotas: case# 9876543211 — approved for requested limits, rollouts should not be blocked by networking.

marco: Great progress. Please mark this thread with case IDs and final approvals. We'll sync at next infra stand. :thumbsup:
